id: title:Gilbert09:treat missing selected fields as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a deterministic, non-retryable classification for BigQuery warehouse ingestion failures caused by missing selected fields, distinguishing them from transient errors; this could help PostHog users avoid repeated failed ingestion attempts and guide remediation.
review.reason: Adds a deterministic, non-retryable classification for BigQuery warehouse ingestion failures caused by missing selected fields, distinguishing them from transient errors; this could help PostHog users avoid repeated failed ingestion attempts and guide remediation.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a specific correctness and reliability improvement (distinguishing retryable from non-retryable errors) and the addition of regression tests. However, the actual benefit of this distinction in a live production environment is not independently verified, and the score does not account for unverified outcomes.
